SettingsResponse.description:
Settings response, exposing a resolved (display) database path.

The active path (currently opened by the sidecar) is reported separately so
the UI can show a pending restart-required change (SRS §5.13).
SettingsResponse.title: SettingsResponse

get.description: Return the aggregate dashboard for a week (defaults to the current week).

post.description: Transition a milestone to a new status.

get.description: List projects, optionally filtered by status (``None`` returns all).

delete.description: Permanently delete a project and its cascaded records.

get.description: List a project's milestones (ordered) with session-minute totals.
Return a project's raw Markdown plan content.

put.description: Persist a project's Markdown plan content.

get.description: List all weekly reviews, most recent first.
Return the review for *week_key*, or a transient blank one if absent.

post.description: Persist a manual score override (requires a non-empty reason).

get.description: List all sessions for a given week.

post.description: Create a session, applying the configured default duration when omitted.

put.description: Update a session's editable fields (week key re-derived from date).

post.description: Reschedule a session and recompute its week key.
Transition a session to a new status.

get.description: Return current settings, including the active database path.

put.description:
Persist settings. A database-path change reports ``restart_required``.

The response's ``active_database_path`` differs from ``resolved_database_path``
when a restart is pending, so the UI can surface the difference.

get.description:
Report operational readiness by probing the database.

:returns: ``{"status": "ready"}`` when the database responds.
:rtype: dict[str, str]
